policy.title: Usage Policies
items: No guarantee is provided regarding approval of agricultural loans, insurance, or government grants.
This platform must not be used as a substitute for professional medical, legal, or official government decisions.
Area, date, unit of measurement, and source must be verified before publishing market rates.
Fake listings, fraud, misleading weight or grade information, and unauthorized charges are strictly prohibited.
Personal data must only be utilized in direct accordance with operational service requirements.
